question.text: What will be the Caldara–Iacoviello Geopolitical Risk Index for November 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the value of the monthly Caldara and Iacoviello geopolitical risk index (GPR) for November 2026, according to the GPR Index [website](https://www.matteoiacoviello.com/gpr.htm), when accessed by Metaculus on or after December 1, 2026.
question.fine_print:
This question will not re-resolve based on future revisions.

The numbers can be found at the monthly data Excel file, under the "GPR" column.

research:
## 1. Resolution source

- 2026-10-29: I couldn't read the official page or the data file directly. matteoiacoviello.com/gpr.htm is larger than the fetch tool's size limit, and data_gpr_export.xls only came back as unreadable binary. So I could not confirm any value against the primary source. [GPR page](https://www.matteoiacoviello.com/gpr.htm)
- 2026-10-14: Valtor Partners republishes the authors' monthly series and says it downloaded it from the site on Oct 14. Its CSV lists **September 2026 GPR = 146.2**, labelled preliminary. [Valtor CSV](https://valtorpartners.com/data/gpr-monthly.csv), [Valtor page](https://valtorpartners.com/geopolitical-risk/)
- A MacroMicro search snippet shows August 2026 at 118.20, with an unlabelled 149.60 beside it. Valtor has August at 125.6. The gap may come from a revision or a different series. I couldn't open the page (403 error), so this conflict is unresolved. [MacroMicro](https://en.macromicro.me/collections/6447/geopolitical-risk)
- The October 2026 value should be published around Nov 1. November 2026 should appear around Dec 1. The question uses the first value published and ignores later revisions.

## 2. Current status

- Nothing has settled the question yet. November hasn't started.
- 2026-10-13: Valtor puts the 7-day average to Oct 13 at 186.6. This is probably the daily index, which uses fewer newspapers than the monthly one. It suggests early October ran well above September's 146.2. [Valtor](https://valtorpartners.com/geopolitical-risk/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)

- 2026-10-29: Iran says 3 to 4 tankers hit mines while trying to cross Hormuz. US Central Command calls this "FALSE" and says the main routes are clear of mines. WTI is about $101.86. [Fox News live](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/us-iran-war-trump-speaks-strait-hormuz-10-28-26), [AP via Daily Gazette](https://www.dailygazette.com/ade/ap/business/iran-says-3-oil-tankers-struck-mines-and-other-mideast-news/article_4b8dfe03-fe8c-553c-adbc-4b938d95844f.html)
- 2026-10-28: Fox sources say the US is moving forces into position: an extra carrier strike group, a Marine expeditionary unit, and a Patriot battery in Israel. They say no decision has been made. The WSJ reports that Gulf allies were told to prepare for a "short, intense campaign" after the midterms. Houthi missiles were intercepted over Saudi Arabia, and the Houthis struck Aden airport. [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/us-iran-war-trump-speaks-strait-hormuz-10-28-26)
- 2026-10-27: Asked about strikes after the midterms, Trump said "anything's possible". He has called off major strikes six times since July. Iran describes the situation as "neither war nor peace" and is pursuing a seven-day mediation proposal. [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/us-iran-war-trump-speaks-strait-hormuz-10-28-26)
- 2026-10-25: IMF PortWatch shows Hormuz commercial transits at about 2% of pre-crisis levels. A tracker reports "Strait of Hormuz Closed, Day 241". [straits.live](https://straits.live/)
- 2026-10-23: The State Department ordered non-emergency staff to leave Saudi Arabia. [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/live-news/us-iran-war-trump-speaks-strait-hormuz-10-28-26)
- 2026-10-28: Oil prices, inflation and geopolitics are supporting the dollar (DXY above 102). Lula's re-election moved markets but isn't a geopolitical event in the index's sense. [FXStreet](https://www.fxstreet.com/news/us-dollar-index-dxy-holds-above-10200-as-bulls-seem-hesitant-ahead-of-crucial-us-data-202610290155)

## 4. Base rates (monthly GPR, Valtor mirror)

- 2026: Jan 168.0, Feb 121.6, **Mar 330.2** (US strikes on Iran begin; the daily index hit 564.93 on Mar 2), Apr 248.2, May 202.1, Jun 178.0, Jul 167.9, Aug 125.6, Sep 146.2. [Valtor CSV](https://valtorpartners.com/data/gpr-monthly.csv), [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/parhizj/geopolitical-risk-gpr-index-600-in)
- 2025: Jan 113.2, Feb 137.0, Mar 175.9, Apr 141.2, May 167.0, Jun 222.3 (Israel-Iran war), Jul 134.2, Aug 139.0, Sep 124.1, Oct 154.3, **Nov 104.2**, Dec 132.5.
- 2024: Jul 92.4, Aug 141.0, Sep 130.4, Oct 130.7, **Nov 128.9**, Dec 142.4.
- Annual averages: 2024 134.5, 2025 145.4, 2026 Jan-Sep 187.5. The 12-month average is 173.2. [Valtor](https://valtorpartners.com/geopolitical-risk/)
- From these numbers: month-to-month moves since 2024 are usually 10 to 45 points. Escalation months jump much more (Feb to Mar 2026: +209; May to Jun 2025: +55). Since 2024 the index has been below 100 only once (Jul 2024: 92.4) and above 300 only once (Mar 2026). The last two Novembers were relatively low (128.9 and 104.2).
- The question's range is 100 to 300. Several 2026 months fell between 120 and 250.

## 5. Other forecasts

- I found no Metaculus, Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on the November 2026 monthly GPR.
- Manifold asks whether the daily GPR reaches 600 in 2026. It was about 12% at snapshot, and a commenter reports seeing it near 7%. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/parhizj/geopolitical-risk-gpr-index-600-in)
- Polymarket, US carriers in CENTCOM on Nov 30: 2 carriers 48.5%, 3 carriers 41.5%, 4 or more 3.8%. This points to a large military presence continuing.
- Kalshi Fear & Greed: for Nov 6, "Fear" 47% and "Extreme Fear" 17%. For Nov 13, "Fear" 37% and "Extreme Fear" 20%. Only loosely related to the question.
- The other Kalshi markets supplied (paper prices, IBOVESPA, KOSPI, CFNAI) are not relevant.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution

- ~2026-11-01: The October 2026 GPR is published. It's a useful anchor; early-October daily readings ran high.
- 2026-11-03: US midterm elections. Reported plans for a "short, intense" US campaign against Iran afterwards, with possible targets at Pickaxe Mountain and Kharg Island, are the biggest upside risk. The March 2026 strikes produced a monthly reading of 330. Heavy election coverage could also lower the share of articles about geopolitics. That second point is my own reasoning, not something a source states.
- November: Iran's seven-day mediation proposal and the US blockade or Hormuz talks could bring de-escalation, which would push the index down. Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and Yemen, and incidents with mines or tankers in Hormuz, could keep it up.
- ~2026-12-01: The November value is published and the question resolves.

The monthly figures below come from a third-party mirror (Valtor Partners) that says it copies the Caldara-Iacoviello series. I could not check them against the primary file, so verify the latest values there directly.

## 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on the "GPR" column of the monthly Excel file at [matteoiacoviello.com/gpr.htm](https://www.matteoiacoviello.com/gpr.htm). The page was too large to fetch. When I fetched the [data file](https://www.matteoiacoviello.com/gpr_files/data_gpr_export.xls), the binary came back unreadable. Its labels show the index is scaled so that 1985-2019 = 100.
- 2026-10 (accessed): the mirror's latest monthly value is **September 2026 = 146.2**, marked preliminary (Threats 173.1, Acts 144.3). [Valtor](https://valtorpartners.com/geopolitical-risk/), [CSV](https://valtorpartners.com/data/gpr-monthly.csv)
- The October 2026 value is probably not out yet and should come in early November. The November value should appear in early December, so it may be preliminary when Metaculus checks on or after Dec 1.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the outcome yet. November newspaper coverage hasn't happened.
- The main driver is a US/Israel-Iran war that began around early March 2026 and is still going roughly eight months later. [CBS](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-trump-us-diplomacy-oil-prices-strait-of-hormuz/)
- 2026-03-02: the daily GPR reached 564.93 on the day of the first strike on Iran, its highest 2026 daily reading. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/parhizj/geopolitical-risk-gpr-index-600-in)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-29: the US dollar index is near a two-week high on oil-driven inflation worries and geopolitical uncertainty. [FXStreet](https://www.fxstreet.com/news/us-dollar-index-dxy-holds-above-10200-as-bulls-seem-hesitant-ahead-of-crucial-us-data-202610290155)

## 4. Base rates (monthly GPR, from the mirror)
- 2024: 160.4, 146.6, 133.2, 163.9, 130.5, 113.1, 92.4, 141.0, 130.4, 130.7, **Nov 128.9**, 142.4.
- 2025: 113.2, 137.0, 175.9, 141.2, 167.0, 222.3 (June, Israel-Iran strikes), 134.2, 139.0, 124.1, 154.3, **Nov 104.2**, 132.5. Full-year average 145.4.
- 2026: Jan 168.0, Feb 121.6, **Mar 330.2** (war starts), Apr 248.2, May 202.1, Jun 178.0, Jul 167.9, Aug 125.6, Sep 146.2. The January-September average is 187.5.
- Since the March peak the index has trended down, settling at about 125-170 in July-September even though the war continues.
- Typical month-to-month moves are about ±10-40 points. Shocks can be much bigger: +209 from February to March 2026 and +55 from May to June 2025.
- In the last two years November came in low (128.9 and 104.2). That pattern rests on only two data points.
- 9 of the 33 months from 2024-01 to 2026-09 were above 170, and 4 were below 115. Note that the question's range starts at 100.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on the monthly GPR value for November 2026.
- Manifold, "GPR daily ≥600 in 2026": about 12% YES, a related tail-risk signal. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/parhizj/geopolitical-risk-gpr-index-600-in)
- Polymarket, number of US aircraft carriers in CENTCOM on Nov 30: 2 at 48.5%, 3 at 41.5%, 0-1 at about 10% combined. Traders expect a heavy US military presence in the region to continue.
- Kalshi Fear & Greed: Fear or Extreme Fear is about 64% for Nov 6 and about 57% for Nov 13, a sign of continuing risk-off sentiment.
- I found no expert forecast of the November GPR level.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Early November 2026: the October GPR should be released, and September may be revised. This will be the latest reading to anchor on.
- November 2026: Iran diplomacy, either a conditional reopening of Hormuz or a breakdown and new escalation. Escalation would push articles about war and threats sharply higher, while a deal would probably pull the index down.
- Ongoing: the Russia-Ukraine refinery strikes, Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia (with Egypt getting involved) and the upcoming Israeli election. [CBS](https://www.cbsnews.com/live-updates/iran-war-trump-us-diplomacy-oil-prices-strait-of-hormuz/)
- Methodology: Iacoviello and Tong released an AI-based index (AI-GPR) in a working paper dated Sept 25, 2026. The question resolves on the classic "GPR" column, so the AI-GPR should not count. [paper](https://www.matteoiacoviello.com/research_files/AI_GPR_PAPER.pdf)

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** About one month. November 2026 runs through Nov 30, and the value should be published around Dec 1, 2026.

(b) **Latest known value:** September 2026 GPR = 146.2 (preliminary, from the Valtor mirror of the authors' series, downloaded Oct 14). October is not yet published. Early-October daily readings (7-day average about 187 on Oct 13) suggest October will come in around 165-190.

(c) **If nothing changed:** The month would be like September/October, roughly 150-175. The Hormuz standoff would continue under a "neither war nor peace" situation, with intermittent Houthi and mine incidents.

(d) **If the current trend continued:** The index has been rising from August (125.6) to September (146.2) to a likely higher October, and escalation signals are building: extra carrier, Marine unit, Patriot battery, talk of a post-midterm campaign, evacuation of non-emergency staff from Saudi Arabia. On that path November could land around 170-200. Heavy midterm coverage in early November dilutes the geopolitical share of articles and works against this.

(e) **Historical variation:**
- Month-to-month moves are typically 10-45 points.
- Escalation months jump far more, such as +209 into March 2026 when the strikes began and +55 into June 2025.
- The last two Novembers were relatively low (128.9 and 104.2).
- 2026 months have ranged from 121.6 to 330.2.

(f) **Experts and markets:** No market exists on this quantity. Polymarket expects 2-3 carriers in CENTCOM on Nov 30, which implies a sustained heavy military posture. Manifold gives about 7-12% to the daily GPR reaching 600 in 2026, so a March-scale shock is seen as unlikely but possible. I put the probability of a major US strike campaign starting in November at roughly 25%, given that Trump has called off strikes six times. That would push the monthly value into the 220-330 range.

(g) **Unexpected scenarios:**
- **Low:** The mediation proposal succeeds, Hormuz reopens, and US news is dominated by midterm aftermath. The monthly value falls to around 105-120, similar to November 2025.
- **High:** A "short, intense campaign" against Iran begins right after Nov 3, including strikes on Kharg Island, Iranian retaliation on Gulf states, and mass tanker incidents. That produces a March-2026-like reading of 300-350.
